desc:
🏃 Every step makes you FASTER! Outrun the chasers, earn Wins, and become the fastest Husser!

CODES: HUSSVALLEY, RELEASE, SPEED

🛸 UPDATE 2 IS HERE!
🌊 3 NEW WORLDS: The Deep Ocean, Haunted Graveyard & Outer Space
👑 NEW Premium Lucky Block with 4 exclusive pets
👽 UFOs that beam you up, whales, ghosts & more flying around every world
⚡ Faster start: jump straight in and run!
📬 Suggestion Mailbox: tell us your ideas in game!

💎 BONUSES
💎 Roblox Premium members get +10% Speed, Wins & Luck!
👥 Play with a friend for another +10%!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
🏃 Run from the chasers: every wave you beat pays Wins
💪 Train on the Hussers to get more Speed
🎀 Buy better headbands to train faster
🐾 Open lucky blocks for pets that boost your Speed
🔁 Rebirth for a permanent multiplier
🌍 Finish a course to unlock the next world

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for more updates!
👥 Join the group for a FREE daily chest!
